# `Q-12-13` — Listing Item Produced No Preview Content

> A listing item produced no preview content; a static fallback
> description is used in its place.

## What this means

Each item in a listing usually shows a short preview — the
first paragraph or an explicit `description:` from the source
document. To build that preview, Quarto looks for preview-eligible
content in the rendered output of the source. This warning fires
when Quarto cannot find any: the rendered output is empty, has
only non-preview-eligible content (headings, raw HTML, ...), or
the source render did not produce a sibling file Quarto could
inspect.

The item still appears in the listing, with a static fallback
description.

## Why this happens

Common causes:

- **The item is a near-empty document** — no body paragraph
  before the first heading, no `description:` in front matter.
- **The item's front matter has nothing the listing template
  knows to surface** (no `title`, no `description`).
- **A custom render path** (filter, post-processor) stripped
  the content the preview pass would have used.

## How to fix

Add a `description:` field to the item's front matter, or write
a short opening paragraph before the first heading. Both are
preview-eligible and will replace the fallback.

## Related

- `Q-12-16` — sibling output unreadable: a related failure mode
  where the file existed but could not be read.
